callees.name: REGISTRY[lang].call_edges
callees.pre_condition: lang is a language key present in REGISTRY; proj_dir is a directory path
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping caller FQN strings to iterables of callee FQN strings if the CodeGraph backend is available for the language, where the FQNs use the canonicalized format; returns None if the backend is unavailable, indicating the caller must use regex-based extraction for this language
